written.headline: LVMH media division adopts ChatGPT Enterprise alongside internal AI platform
written.summary: LVMH’s media division is deploying OpenAI's ChatGPT Enterprise to its teams. The luxury group already operates its own internal multi-model platform, MaIA, which had about 50,000 users as of mid-2026.

written.headline: Anthropic IPO tests its public benefit commitment
written.summary: Anthropic plans an initial public offering this month while maintaining its status as a public benefit corporation. Experts highlight that its governance structure leaves wide leeway in measuring its commitment to society.

written.headline: Baidu posts sixth straight quarterly sales drop as ad slump offsets AI cloud growth
written.summary: Baidu reported Q3 revenue down 1% year-over-year to approximately $4.6 billion, marking its sixth consecutive quarterly sales decline. Net income came in at approximately $210 million (1.4 billion yuan), while AI businesses now make up over 50% of its revenue.

written.headline: Startups unveil plans for floating offshore data centers
written.summary: Startups are announcing plans to develop floating offshore data centers to bypass land and power constraints. Experts have warned of challenges including saltwater corrosion.

written.headline: China pushes toward nationwide AI education in schools by 2030
written.summary: China is pursuing a national target for universal AI literacy in schools by 2030, supported by over $31 million in government procurement for AI classroom equipment and teaching platforms. Schools are introducing AI-focused curricula to teach programming, robotics, and AI application.

written.headline: Oister Global launches ₹600 Cr growth-stage deeptech fund
written.summary: Private markets asset manager Oister Global launched a growth-stage deeptech fund with a target corpus of ₹400 Cr and a ₹200 Cr greenshoe option. The fund aims to back 8 to 10 revenue-generating Indian startups across sectors including space, defence, and semiconductors.
